description:
Describe one or all apartments: size, bedrooms, maximum guests, description and page link.

Use for questions about the apartments themselves ("how big is #16?", "which apartment has 2 bedrooms?",
"which apartments fit 5 people?"). It contains no prices or availability — use check_availability for
dates and prices, or get_rates for a month overview. Studio #17 is only listed when asked for by number and
is marked as bookable on request. Visual version with photos: render_apartment_gallery.
Behaviour: read-only; facts as maintained on praegant.net (synced hourly), answers in milliseconds.
Returns text plus structuredContent.apartments (nr, name, m2, bedrooms, max_guests, description, url,
on_request, images). An unknown number returns the list of existing apartment numbers.

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
language.title: Language

name.description: Apartment number such as '12' or '#16'; empty or 'all' = all online-bookable apartments; '17' = Studio #17 (on request only)
name.title: Name

name: get_apartment_details

on_request.description: True = not bookable online, enquiry only

url.description: Apartment page, or the enquiry form for on-request apartments

title: Get Apartment Details
